grid.description: The grid; absent takes every grid default.

pitch.description: The world lattice's pitch on X, Y and Z, in world units; every component positive.

planeY.description: The working plane's height, in world units, when the mode is Plane.

lineWidth.description: The drawn line's width, in pixels; positive.

grid.title: WorldEditorGrid

snap.description: The snapping; absent takes every snapping default.

enabled.description: Whether positions snap to the grid.

angleStepDegrees.description: The angle a turn steps and a rotation snaps to, in degrees; in (0, 180].

surface.description: Whether a placement rests on the surface under the pointer.

objectPatchRadius.description: How far a captured reference's own grid reaches around it, in multiples of its largest half extent; positive.

snap.title: WorldEditorSnap

camera.description: The editor camera's feel; absent takes every camera default.

orbitRate.description: The orbit rate at full input, in radians per second; positive.

panRate.description: The pan rate at full input, in world units per second; positive.

zoomRate.description: The exponential dolly rate at full input, per second; positive.

flyRate.description: The fly rate at full input, in world units per second; positive.

minPitch.description: The lowest orbit pitch, in radians; above -π/2 and below MaxPitch.

maxPitch.description: The highest orbit pitch, in radians; below π/2.

minDistance.description: The nearest orbit distance, in world units; positive and below MaxDistance.

maxDistance.description: The farthest orbit distance, in world units.

camera.title: WorldEditorCamera
